description.zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the security group. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
The array of security group IDs. Array length: 0 to 10.

title.zh: 查询被授权的安全组列表

descriptions.zh: -  当您无法删除某一安全组（[DeleteSecurityGroup](~~25558~~)）时，可以调用该接口查看指定的安全组是否已被其他安全组授权。如果指定的安全组已被授权，您可以通过[RevokeSecurityGroup](~~2679855~~)和[RevokeSecurityGroupEgress](~~2679856~~)删除对应的安全组规则来解除授权行为。
descriptions.en: -  If you cannot delete a security group ([DeleteSecurityGroup](~~25558~~)), you can call this operation to check whether the specified security group has been authorized by other security groups. If the specified security group has been authorized, you can call [RevokeSecurityGroup](~~2679855~~) and [RevokeSecurityGroupEgress](~~2679856~~) to delete the corresponding security group rules to revoke the authorization.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-security-group-references --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-group-id sg-bp14vtedjtobkvi0000 --region cn-hangzhou
